title: Ground and soil
summary: The ground is covered with grass over soil: a mixture of broken rock, dead plant material and living things.

layers.basics: Soil is not just dirt. It holds tiny grains of rock, the remains of dead plants and animals, water, air, and an enormous number of living things, from earthworms to microbes. Plant roots anchor in it and drink from it. Zoom in to see the grains.
layers.deeper: Grains of mineral are held together by humus, the dark decayed material. Fungi and bacteria break down dead matter and release nutrients that plants take up. Tree roots reach out through the soil with the help of fungal partners (mycorrhiza).
layers.expert: The close-up is a simplified view of soil grains and organisms, not a sample of real soil. The park is a simplified scene, not a scan of a real place.
